additional_info.subject: Connector Fault on Sicharge D – MPR8170002536
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Team,
I would like to report an issue observed on one of the two connectors of the
Sicharge D – MPR8170002536
unit. The affected connector is currently in
fault mode
, showing an
internal error
, which may be related to a software component or another underlying cause.
The last status update was recorded on
April 19th, 2025 at 18:33:21
.
Could you please investigate the root cause of this issue?
It would also be helpful to check whether this might be related to a
software update
or any other system-related event.
I remain at your disposal for any further information.
Kind regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.

additional_info.subject: ID0419761-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / R8 170002536] Internal Error CRM:02023000585
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek DRIF,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Vikas
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R8 170002536
Charger ID/Serial No.
:
AP1DUJ
Problem Description
: Internal Error
Troubleshooting
:
We have reviewed the reported logs and observed that on DC2, the pilot state changed from B to E, which resulted in an internal error status on the DC2 outlet. The pilot state transition was triggered due to a V2G message timeout. Currently, both outlets are available and there are no active error flags on the SCB. Please confirm if we can proceed with closing the ticket.
For future reference, your case number is
0419761
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

change
the

replying
to it.
